ns2:course.label: Senior Design Project
ns2:course.description: Students are required to solve an actual, real world design problem; to develop, evaluate, and recommend alternative solutions; and to satisfy realistic constraints that include most of the following considerations: economic; environmental; sustainability; manufacturability; ethical; health and safety; social; and political. Same as IE 470. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing in mechanical engineering or industrial engineering; completion of or concurrent enrollment in all required courses; completion of campus Composition I general education requirement.
